assessments.reasoning: The complete pinned file places the project grant above “Version 3, 29 June 2007”. Its closing model notice has a different evidentiary role from the project header.

All three contiguous rsync.c parts share the COPYING commit and cover 34,707 bytes with file digest 11cb17fa43e5849fd8e3ff45a2a3fd1eeee4b25955d5646d0952e41b9b53c0b3. The opening comment credits Andrew Tridgell, Paul Mackerras and Wayne Davison and contains the operative later-version choice.
The generated detail provides contextual evidence of use with GPL-3.0. Its usage comment supplies neither an exclusive edition nor a project-wide version declaration.

challenge.method: Tested GPL-3.0-only against the program header. Also tested whether the sample notice in COPYING or the SPDX usage comment could independently establish the program’s later-version option.
challenge.results: The header resolves the version choice directly. The sample notice is guidance for applying the GPL. SPDX says the exception “has been used with GPL-3.0”, which is consistent with the named edition and leaves the later-version choice open.

limitations: This establishes the exception placement and the program declaration in rsync.c at one revision. License notices in other files and the terms for a particular distribution require their own evidence.
reasoning: At rsync commit 02cfb7621cfea47b49aa30886ab0e4e3e03e78f8, COPYING prints the exception immediately before GNU GPL version 3. The opening copyright and license notice in rsync.c expressly grants version 3 or, at the recipient’s option, any later version.
